args.description: Deterministic drawing-write tool: rearranges every existing panel entity (closed polylines on the Panels layer, or as specified) into positions forming a recognizable sitting-cat silhouette. Must preserve each panel (same handle/identity, size, shape — only reposition/rotate, no create/delete/resize). Must support a dry_run parameter that computes and returns the proposed new layout (e.g. panel handle -> new position/rotation, plus a summary/preview) WITHOUT mutating the drawing. When dry_run is false and the write is approved, it applies the rearrangement and commits a new immutable drawing version (does not overwrite prior versions). Deterministic: given the same input panel set, always produces the same silhouette mapping (e.g. panels sorted by handle/current position assigned in fixed order to fixed target silhouette anchor points scaled/centered to the current panel bounding extents). Capability: drawing.write.
